projects.title: IPAS Secure
projects.description:
The IMSYS Presence Awareness System is a real time tracking and access control solution. IPAS Secure is designed to provide real time visibility of people and assets and to enable automated data collection of asset information, including location. IPAS Secure is a highly configurable software application that uses active RFID tags and readers to track the location of people and assets throughout secure facilities. Combined with industry standard access control, e.g. HID Global, IPAS Secure gives you the ability to monitor and manage facilities and key business processes.

IDEs: Visual Studio, Web Matrix
Tech: C#, AJAX, jQuery, Socket, SIP, PHP, CSS3, SQL server, MVC

projects.title: Alacrita Database
projects.description:
Our group of independent consultants continues to grow (>100 now). We’d like an online a system manages their information, allowing:

 easier processing of new consultants
 existing consultants to update their information easily and without our involvement
 for us to quickly and easily query the database to find consultants with expertise that matches a client’s needs

Tech: HTML, PHP, JavaScript, AJAX, MySQL, CSS
